name: 前置摄像头近景自拍视频
description: 单手举起手机前置摄像头拍摄的近景视频，强调眼神交流、微表情变化与近场呼吸感。

vocal_policy.lipsync_prompt_injection: speaking naturally to the camera with subtle lip movement and expressive eyes

locked_prompt.camera_prefix: Handheld front-facing iPhone selfie video, close-up head and shoulders framing, subtle natural arm sway and breathing micro-jitter.
locked_prompt.temporal_rules: Natural blinking, subtle head tilt, hair reacting gently to air movement, unscripted candid presence.
locked_prompt.sfx_foley_base: Close-up smartphone mic audio, subtle breathing, quiet indoor room tone, no background music.
locked_prompt.realism_suffix: Raw unedited mobile clip, natural ambient lighting, authentic skin texture.

primary_subject.instruction: 绑定角色 asset_id，描述单一连续微表情或手势（如单手托腮叹气、挑眉微笑），不超过10个英文单词

secondary_subject.instruction: 可选，靠近脸旁手持的小物件（如咖啡杯、冰袋）

environment_and_sound.instruction: 描述身后局部背景光线微动及具体环境底噪（如办公室空调低鸣、卧室台灯暖光），不超过12个英文单词

name: 镜面及反光介质动态自拍
description: 对着镜子或玻璃橱窗拍摄的半身/全身短视频，手机清晰入镜，伴随轻微侧身或整理衣角动作。

locked_prompt.camera_prefix: Handheld iPhone mirror selfie video, half-body reflection shot, holding a smartphone clearly visible in hand, subtle natural hand sway.
locked_prompt.temporal_rules: Natural fabric folding and draping with movement, soft ambient light shifting slightly across the room.
locked_prompt.sfx_foley_base: Quiet indoor room tone, soft clothing fabric rustling sound, subtle footsteps, no background music.
locked_prompt.realism_suffix: Raw unedited mobile clip, realistic indoor lighting, authentic everyday footage.

primary_subject.instruction: 绑定角色 asset_id，描述对镜微动姿势（如低头看手机屏幕并单手整理衣领、轻微侧身展示穿搭），不超过12个英文单词

secondary_subject.instruction: 可选，镜前或脚边的关联物（如脚边的宠物、拎着的包）

environment_and_sound.instruction: 描述镜面所处的真实室内环境（如玄关走廊、健身房器械区、电梯间）及环境微声，不超过12个英文单词

name: 友人视角后置生活流抓拍
description: 友人用手机后置镜头拍摄的半身或全身生活抓拍视频，人物处于连贯日常互动状态中。

locked_prompt.camera_prefix: Candid third-person video shot on an iPhone rear camera, natural 26mm focal length, subtle handheld operator breathing movement.
locked_prompt.temporal_rules: Unposed natural movement, background pedestrians or foliage swaying gently, natural depth of field.
locked_prompt.sfx_foley_base: Authentic ambient environmental audio, distant soft chatter, tableware clinking or street murmur, no background music.
locked_prompt.realism_suffix: Raw unedited mobile footage, mixed ambient lighting, natural color science.

primary_subject.instruction: 绑定角色 asset_id，描述角色正在进行的连贯生活动作（如低头搅拌咖啡后抬头看窗外、夹起食物），不超过12个英文单词

secondary_subject.instruction: 可选，角色面前或手中的互动物件（如笔记本电脑、餐盘、宠物）

environment_and_sound.instruction: 描述所在餐厅、街道或公园背景动态及对应的真实环境音，不超过12个英文单词

name: 第一人称主观视角拍物交互
description: 模拟角色低头俯拍或平视拍摄眼前物品、宠物或食物的 3 秒短视频，角色仅以局部手部入画。

locked_prompt.camera_prefix: First-person POV iPhone rear camera video, 45-degree downward close-up angle, subtle handheld breathing micro-jitter, natural autofocus pull.
locked_prompt.temporal_rules: Single continuous micro-interaction, realistic shadows and surface reflections, subtle ambient light shift.
locked_prompt.sfx_foley_base: Close-up smartphone mic audio, crisp tactile foley sound, quiet indoor room tone, zero background music.
locked_prompt.realism_suffix: Raw unedited mobile clip, natural lighting, authentic everyday snapshot.

primary_subject.instruction: 主体物件或宠物及它的微动态（如热气腾腾的拉面、蜷缩打呼噜的橘猫、杯中旋转的冰块），不超过10个英文单词

secondary_subject.instruction: 可选，仅描述画面边缘露出的角色手部动作与袖口颜色（严禁出现人脸描述），不超过10个英文单词

environment_and_sound.instruction: 描述桌面/地面材质及具体的近景发声介质（如冰块碰撞塑料杯、纸张翻动声、猫咪呼噜声），不超过12个英文单词

name: 手持边走边拍动态 Vlog
description: 角色边走边手持拍摄的 6 秒动态视频，具备真实的脚步上下起伏节奏与户外风噪。

vocal_policy.lipsync_prompt_injection: speaking casually to the camera while walking, natural mouth movement

locked_prompt.camera_prefix: Raw handheld iPhone selfie video while walking, 24mm wide-angle lens, rhythmic walking camera bob and natural handheld motion.
locked_prompt.temporal_rules: Continuous forward walking movement, background scenery passing steadily, hair and clothes reacting to breeze, natural blinking.
locked_prompt.sfx_foley_base: Outdoor smartphone mic audio, subtle wind buffeting on mic, rhythmic footsteps on pavement, distant city traffic noise, no background music.
locked_prompt.realism_suffix: Raw unedited mobile footage, natural daylight or streetlamp dynamic range, authentic social media clip.

primary_subject.instruction: 若为角色自拍则填 asset_id 并描述走路神态（如迎风微眯眼微笑）；若为第一人称走路空镜则描述前方路面，不超过12个英文单词

secondary_subject.instruction: 可选，手里拎着的袋子、咖啡杯或身旁同行的宠物

environment_and_sound.instruction: 描述身后掠过的街道建筑、树影、灯光时间段及脚步/风声细节，不超过12个英文单词

name: 随手拍纯环境氛围空镜视频
description: 人物完全不入镜的 5 秒环境记录短视频，以微弱手持感捕捉天气、交通或光影流动。

locked_prompt.camera_prefix: Casual handheld iPhone rear camera video of scenery, wide-angle shot, very subtle natural hand tremor.
locked_prompt.temporal_rules: Smooth natural environmental motion such as raindrops sliding, tree leaves swaying, or distant traffic lights moving.
locked_prompt.sfx_foley_base: Pure authentic outdoor or window-side environmental audio, rain, wind, or distant city hum, zero speech, no music.
locked_prompt.realism_suffix: Raw unedited mobile video, natural weather lighting, authentic documentary snapshot.

primary_subject.instruction: 描述核心动态景物或天气现象（如暴雨中的十字路口尾灯、晚霞下的城市天际线），不超过12个英文单词

secondary_subject.instruction: 可选，前景物理遮挡物（如布满雨滴的车前挡风玻璃、阳台铁艺栏杆）

environment_and_sound.instruction: 描述整体时间光照氛围及纯粹自然环境声（如雨滴敲打玻璃声、深夜微风声），不超过12个英文单词
